# Strategy and copy

## Inputs

Approved intake, evidence, brand voice, production-system reference, recorded content class, and hook-research format. Read `references/hook-library.md` for approved-draft hook selection.

## Process

Choose the narrative format that fits the insight: comparison, tutorial, native personal lesson, story arc, or an explicitly approved custom format. Choose the smallest useful slide count. Draft at least three cover hooks and the complete carousel. Make Slide 2 reopen curiosity, use one job per slide, deliver a real payoff, and end with one action. Use the validated five-slide or ten-slide spine when selected. Run AI Sloppy Copy and repair failures.

## Outputs

Completed `copy.md` plus slide roles in `run.json`. Add the exact copy to the manifest. Include the caption and alt text draft.

## Human check

Approve the exact strategy and copy version. Do not start full image production.
